name: game-director
description: Make a fun, playable, rich, working and tested game over many sessions, one step per session with /game-next: ideation and topic-by-topic brainstorming with you, a living agent-facing wiki and a human GDD next to your tasks, then plan, build, verdicts and polish gated by a machine-checked definition of done. Engine-, genre-, platform- and tracker-agnostic.
